intent: Extract from the cohort VCF the variants that lie inside the capture-kit target regions listed in the BED file.
silent_error: bcftools decides the coordinate system of a regions/targets file from its file NAME: only a '.bed' or '.bed.gz' suffix makes it read the file as BED (0-based, half-open); any other name is read as a tab-delimited CHROM BEG END file with 1-based inclusive positions. capture_targets.txt contains BED intervals, so with -R each target is widened by one base on the left and the variants sitting at the BED start coordinate (the base just before the real target) are returned. Nothing is printed and the exit status is 0. Documented in the bcftools man page, Common Options, -R/--regions-file ('To indicate that a file be treated as BED rather than the 1-based tab-delimited file, the file must have the .bed or .bed.gz suffix').
